topics.title: PEMDAS/BODMAS Rules
topics.concept:
Why Order Matters:

3 + 4 × 2 = ?

If you add first: (3+4)×2 = 7×2 = 14 If you multiply first: 3+(4×2) = 3+8 = 11 Which is correct? MULTIPLY first!

PEMDAS (USA) / BODMAS (UK):

LetterStands ForMeaning
P / BParentheses / BracketsDo inside ( ) first
E / OExponents / OrdersPowers and roots
M / DMultiplication / DivisionLeft to right
D / MDivision / MultiplicationLeft to right
A / SAddition / SubtractionLeft to right

Remember: Please Excuse My Dear Aunt Sally
topics.visual:
PEMDAS ORDER OF OPERATIONS:

    ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    │                                     │
    │     P     PARENTHESES (Highest)     │
    │     E     EXPONENTS                 │
    │     M     MULTIPLICATION            │
    │     D     DIVISION                  │
    │     A     ADDITION                  │
    │     S     SUBTRACTION (Lowest)      │
    │                                     │
    └─────────────────────────────────────┘

DECISION TREE FOR SOLVING:

    Start: Look for parentheses
                │
                ▼
           Solve inside ( )
                │
                ▼
          Look for exponents
                │
                ▼
          Multiply or Divide
         (left to right)
                │
                ▼
          Add or Subtract
         (left to right)
                │
                ▼
              Answer!


EXAMPLE WORKFLOW: 3 + 4 × (5 - 2)²

    Step 1: Parentheses: 5 - 2 = 3
           3 + 4 × 3²
    
    Step 2: Exponent: 3² = 9
           3 + 4 × 9
    
    Step 3: Multiply: 4 × 9 = 36
           3 + 36
    
    Step 4: Add: 3 + 36 = 39
    
    Answer: 39
recap: Same level operations = go left to right
